photos.desc: Chicks of Socotra cormorant in Al Aaliya Island, Al Daayen Municipality, Qatar.
Socotra Cormorants , from The Natural History of Sokotra and Abd-el-Kuri . Adult male ( a ), bird probably in second-year plumage ( b ), and bird in first-year plumage ( c ).
Flock of Socotra Cormorants Phalacrocorax nigrogularis , Khasab, Oman
